metadata.description: Red zigzag waves intersect three horizontal blue slowing bands, with additional red waves along the top and bottom. Four pink ring bouncers and one pink diamond eroder roam the field. Four cyan patrols start at the top, left and two right-side positions. Red tiles are lethal until captured; blue tiles slow your craft. Start at bottom center and close cuts on the safe perimeter to reveal 75%.

classRecipes.label: FPV Scout
classRecipes.description: A nimble FPV quad. Scan shows enemy direction hints for four seconds; it never captures territory or slows an enemy.
